verdict.rationale: NVIDIA ships Isaac GR00T, an open reference platform of robot foundation models released under Apache 2. The models generalize across manipulation and multi-step tasks and can be adapted through post-training to specific embodiments, and the platform is described as enabling developers to build, train, test, and deploy AI-powered robots. Isaac ROS adds production ROS 2 packages for AI inference on NVIDIA platforms, giving a supported deployment path, though community comments question how fast the demos run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how GR00T/VLA inference plugs into a ROS 2 autonomy stack, coverage of robot types beyond humanoids, and hands-on corroboration of a successful integration.
